PREFIX brick: <http://brickschema.org/schema/1.2/brick#>
PREFIX ref: <http://w3.org/ns/ldp#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
SELECT ?point ?ts WHERE {
  ?zone a brick:Zone ; brick:hasName "Perimeter_mid_ZN_4" .
  ?point brick:isLocationOf ?zone ; rdf:type brick:AirTemperatureSensor .
  ?point ref:hasTimeseriesId ?ts .
}
SELECT DISTINCT ?p WHERE { ?p a brick:AirTemperatureSensor } LIMIT 10
